message:
The other day, we found ourselves in a rare moment—no screens, no distractions, just us at home. We pulled out some old board games and had a blast reminiscing over forgotten rules and silly family traditions. It reminded us that sometimes, the simplest joys can be the most fulfilling, even when preparing for the unexpected. 

As we start thinking about our emergency go-bags again, it’s a good reminder: while we gather the essentials, let’s not forget to cherish those low-tech moments together. After all, preparedness isn’t just about stuff; it’s about strengthening our connections. What’s your favorite unplugged family activity? 😊
